title: Another Step in the Cloud Ecosystem: OpenAI's Cybersecurity Model Officially Launched on Amazon Platform
excerpt: Recently, Amazon officially announced that two cybersecurity models from OpenAI, Daybreak Red and Daybreak Blue, are now available to eligible Amazon Bedrock us
content_html:
Recently, Amazon officially announced that two cybersecurity models from OpenAI, Daybreak Red and Daybreak Blue, are now available to eligible Amazon Bedrock users. The launch of these two new models not only further deepens the long-term strategic cooperation between the two companies but also marks Amazon's continued expansion of its cloud AI service portfolio.

According to the information, both models are important components of OpenAI's network defense program called Daybreak. Daybreak Red mainly provides access to GPT-5.6Cyber; while Daybreak Blue includes cutting-edge general models such as GPT-5.6Sol, and is specifically optimized and enhanced for defensive cybersecurity applications. Before this, several models from OpenAI, including GPT-5.6Sol, Terra, and Luna, were successively released on Amazon Bedrock in July.

In February of this year, Amazon and OpenAI officially established a multi-year strategic partnership involving an investment of up to $50 billion. As the financial progress advanced, Amazon completed its contributions in the first and second quarters, and by the end of June, it had fully allocated the remaining funds. It has now completed the total $50 billion investment in OpenAI, with a holding percentage of approximately 5%.

While continuously increasing its investment in OpenAI, Amazon has adopted a broad strategy in the artificial intelligence field. In addition to promoting in-depth cooperation with OpenAI, Amazon has recently further expanded its investment and business integration with Anthropic. By building a diversified model distribution channel and vigorously developing its own technology, Amazon is effectively reducing its reliance on a single supplier and continuously driving the rapid growth of AWS cloud services.

content_html_zh:
最近，亚马逊正式宣布 OpenAI 的两种网络安全模型 Daybreak Red 和 Daybreak Blue 现已向符合条件的 Amazon Bedrock 用户开放。 这两款新机型的推出不仅进一步深化了两家公司的长期战略合作，也标志着亚马逊云AI服务组合的持续扩张。

信息显示，这两个模型都是 OpenAI 名为 Daybreak 的网络防御计划的重要组成部分。 Daybreak Red主要提供GPT-5.6Cyber​​的接入； Daybreak Blue则包含GPT-5.6Sol等尖端通用模型，并专门针对防御性网络安全应用进行了优化和增强。 此前，OpenAI 的多款模型，包括 GPT-5.6Sol、Terra、Luna 等，已于 7 月份在 Amazon Bedrock 上陆续发布。

今年2月，亚马逊与OpenAI正式建立多年战略合作伙伴关系，投资额高达500亿美元。 随着财务进展的推进，亚马逊完成了第一季度和第二季度的缴款，到6月底，已全额拨付剩余资金。 目前已完成对OpenAI总计500亿美元的投资，持股比例约为5%。

在不断加大对OpenAI的投入的同时，亚马逊在人工智能领域采取了广泛的战略。 除了推动与OpenAI的深度合作外，亚马逊近期还进一步扩大了与Anthropic的投资和业务整合。 通过构建多元化模式的分销渠道和大力发展自有技术，亚马逊正在有效减少对单一供应商的依赖，持续推动AWS云服务的快速增长。
